properties.displayName: Configure Continuous Export to Log Analytics for Microsoft Defender for Cloud
properties.description: Configure streaming export setting of Defender for Cloud data to Log Analytics.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy

Specifies when the existence of the related resources should be evaluated. The delay is only used for evaluations that are a result of a create or update resource request. Allowed values are AfterProvisioning, AfterProvisioningSuccess, AfterProvisioningFailure, or an ISO 8601 duration between 0 and 360 minutes.
The name of the Defender for Cloud continuous export configuration.
The resource group name where the export configuration will reside.
The location where the resource group and the export configuration are created.
The Log Analytics workspace where Defender for Cloud data will be exported.
Export individual security recommendations with all categories and all severity levels.
Export overall secure score and all secure score controls.
Export all security alerts. Alerts are only exported as streaming updates.
Export a weekly snapshot of the selected data types. Not supported for security alerts.
